title: Alpha as Bifurcation Parameter: The Helical Electron Stability Problem
description: The fine-structure constant alpha ~ 1/137 has resisted derivation for a century. We propose that alpha is a critical eigenvalue of a geometric stability condition: the electron's Zitterbewegung is modelled as a classical light-speed helical null-curve in Minkowski space. The pitch angle separates three regimes: alpha=0 (free line), alpha~1/137 (stable helix), alpha→∞ (confined circle). We conjecture that alpha~1/137 is the unique stationary point of a curvature-torsion energy functional and pose the helical stability problem in precise mathematical terms. This paper does not solve the problem; it identifies it and provides five specific, dated falsifiability conditions.
